question: Should issue-only autonomous imports disable require_fix_before_close by default for every permitted close reason when the cluster has no security signal?
rationale: The code is mechanically consistent, but choosing which autonomous issue closes may proceed without a fix artifact is a repository safety-policy decision.

options.title: Approve bounded issue-only closes
options.body: Accept the exception after confirming generated output and canary it on a limited issue-only batch before broader use.

options.title: Narrow to duplicate closes
options.body: Restrict the exemption to explicitly classified duplicate closes if other issue-only close reasons should remain fix-first.

options.title: Require explicit opt-in
options.body: Keep fix-first as the default and expose issue-only exemption through a deliberate import flag or job setting.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded issue-only closes
recommendation.body: Accept the exception after confirming generated output and canary it on a limited issue-only batch before broader use.
